raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"From Musee Carnavalet, make your way on to Rue de Rivoli, about a two-minute walk away.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Right here, on 21 September 1792, Danton stood and proclaimed the First Republic — and on this same ground, soon after, Louis XVI was brought to trial and sentenced to death.","source_id":"22d32782-f576-4ec9-bdf1-33fc9bbbcc36","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"So how did a king's fate come to be decided on a street corner?","source_id":"22d32782-f576-4ec9-bdf1-33fc9bbbcc36","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Because back in 1720, none of this looked like a street at all — rue de Rivoli didn't even exist XV.","source_id":"22d32782-f576-4ec9-bdf1-33fc9bbbcc36","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Once he left for Versailles, the place kept teaching well-bred youths to ride, fence, dance, and do their mathematics, everything the gentlemanly ideal demanded.","source_id":"22d32782-f576-4ec9-bdf1-33fc9bbbcc36","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Then the Revolution moved in, and the hall that had trained aristocrats became the seat of the National Assembly, and after it the Convention.","source_id":"22d32782-f576-4ec9-bdf1-33fc9bbbcc36","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Look now toward no. 258, a house crying out for repair, once the home of the great statesman Talleyrand — the one man who wormed his way through every shaky regime of the the Tuileries.","source_id":"9ca7823a-0f94-4a60-a78d-2cec58e72291","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"And where so many around him lost their heads, Talleyrand died here of old age on 17 May 1838, aged eighty-six.","source_id":"9ca7823a-0f94-4a60-a78d-2cec58e72291","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3}]}
